candidates.buyer: Small ni-Vanuatu kava processors and exporters (facility holders)
candidates.category: 36. Kava export facility registration and quality management (also 22, 30)
candidates.existing: No software found for kava batch records or export documents (not specifically searched). Trade portal lists steps only.
candidates.name: Kava exporter / processor quality-management and export-document pack
candidates.trigger: Kava Act 2002; Biosecurity OPS-014 Kava Quality Management Procedures: facility certification, annual audit, VCMB export licence, per-shipment phytosanitary and export certificates, moisture (5%) and kavalactone/flavokavin test records. Biosecurity reminded industry in Aug 2026.
candidates.unchecked: Number of certified facilities; whether OPS-014 requires batch records; local-language competitor search not run (budget exhausted); VCMB licence renewal cycle; who pays (exporters vs buyers).

candidates.buyer: Sole traders and family shops across Vanuatu, plus their accountants
candidates.category: 31. Annual business licence renewal and quarterly turnover returns (also 19)
candidates.existing: Only DCIR email reminders (irtps@vanuatu.gov.vu); no Vanuatu compliance calendar app found in one competitor search (query: Vanuatu business licence renewal compliance reminder software app SME VAT). Related to K01 but different duty and buyer.
candidates.known_note: Adjacent to K01 (VAT reconciliation for accountants) but covers the licence/permit renewal duty.
candidates.name: Annual business licence renewal and turnover-return calendar for micro-businesses
candidates.trigger: Business Licence Act Cap 249: renew by 31 Jan; fee on prior-year gross turnover per licence category; 10% penalty per month; sector permits (municipal, vehicle, tourism, marine, health, industry) and VFSC/VFIPA certificates required; quarterly turnover return form; monthly VAT.
candidates.unchecked: Business count; willingness to pay; payment is in person so the tool is only prep/reminder; connectivity on outer islands.

candidates.buyer: About 460 registered co-operatives (about 17,400 members) and the Registrar's office
candidates.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
candidates.existing: None found; competitor search not run.
candidates.name: Co-operative society annual return, accounts and audit pack
candidates.trigger: Co-operative Societies Act Cap 152 Part 6 (ss35-38): annual returns, audit, Registrar inspection; Rules 1987 on annual accounts and audit.
candidates.unchecked: Deadlines and forms; how many co-ops are active; low willingness to pay; donor-funded context; competitor search in English/French.

candidates.buyer: Small law firms, real estate agents, money changers, accountants that are FIU reporting entities
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with AML reports (also 19)
candidates.name: AML reporting-entity compliance kit for DNFBPs (real estate, lawyers, money changers)
candidates.trigger: AML/CTF Act 13 of 2014: register of reporting entities, STR/SAR/CTR/IFTR/BCR/CCR reports; penalties up to VT25 million; FIU 2026 real-estate analysis; 2026 amendment bill (FIU to move to RBV); National AML Strategy Aug 2025; FIU forces unregistered businesses to halt.
candidates.unchecked: Which professions are actually registered; volume of reports from DNFBPs; whether the FIU has an online filing portal; competitor search.

candidates.buyer: Foreign-owned small shops, restaurants and service firms
candidates.name: Foreign-owned SME VFIPA certificate renewal and change-notification tracker
candidates.trigger: Foreign Investment Act 25 of 2019 as amended 2021: certificate validity and notification of changes in business details; certificate must be renewed before the business licence; reserved/restricted list review.
candidates.unchecked: Renewal timetable and fees; number of certificate holders; whether VFIPA has an online system; competitor search.

candidates.category: 32. Liquor, kava bar and municipal permits (also 20)
candidates.name: Liquor / kava bar / restaurant municipal permit and liquor licence renewal assistant
candidates.trigger: Liquor Licensing Act Cap 52 (amended 2022): council recommendation, police verification, ministerial approval, payment by 31 Jan; submit 2 months ahead; licences non-transferable; fines VT50,000-100,000.
candidates.unchecked: Count of outlets; whether kava bars need a liquor licence or only a municipal permit; fees; competitor search; process is paper and in person so the value is mostly a reminder/document service.

candidates.buyer: Tour, transfer, activity operators and accommodation providers (guest houses, bungalows, homestays)
candidates.category: 34. Tourism permit and operator minimum standards (also 29)
candidates.name: Tourism operator permit, insurance and standards compliance tracker
candidates.trigger: Tourism permit and business licence tied to minimum standards; public liability insurance required (May 2026); July 2026 reform to single permit with declaration of compliance and tiered sustainability framework.
candidates.unchecked: Reform says permit is a one-time application, which weakens recurrence; operator count (about 2,000 permits expected in 2018 per Daily Post); 100 vatu/night levy unverified; competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Taxi, bus and hire-van owners and drivers (B-plate cap of 1,400)
candidates.name: Public vehicle permit renewal and driver permit assistant for taxi and bus owners
candidates.trigger: PLTA Act 2015 public vehicle permit; driver public vehicle permit valid to 31 Dec each year, renewals from November; business licence; 2026 fuel support package paid only against valid 2026 permit, licence and ID, tied to the phone number on the permit.
candidates.unchecked: Whether PLTA has an online system; very small market; driver permit page is undated; low willingness to pay.

candidates.buyer: Small employers, especially those hiring foreign staff
candidates.category: 26 / 37. Employment Act returns and work permits
candidates.existing: Free state forms and MIDAS portal; related to K03 payroll tools but a different duty.
candidates.name: Employer annual statistical return and foreign-worker work-permit/visa tracker
candidates.trigger: Employment Act Cap 160 s72 annual return (2025 return due end March 2026); Labour (Work Permits) Act Cap 187 fees from 1 July 2025 (VT60,000 temporary, VT30,000 exemption); employment visa renewals via MIDAS portal.
candidates.unchecked: Whether return is online or paper; number of employers hiring foreign workers; competitor search not run.

candidates.buyer: Licensed recruitment agents (60+ in 2020) and RSE/SWP approved employers
candidates.name: Employment agency / seasonal-worker recruiter licence renewal
candidates.trigger: 2007 regulation under Employment Act: annual agent licence, code of conduct, complaints; abolition of agents announced 2020 but not confirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether agents still exist in 2026; current licensing regime; worker-record duties.

candidates.buyer: Small fish processors, exporters, local fishing operators
candidates.name: Fish export processing / local fishing licence and sea cucumber permit handling
candidates.trigger: Fisheries Regulations Cap 315: local fishing licence, fish export processing establishment licence, written ministerial permission for trochus/sea cucumber exports; sea cucumber ban.
candidates.unchecked: Current status of the harvest ban; number of licensees; forms and fees.

candidates.category: 39. Waste operator licences and plastic ban (also 11)
candidates.name: Private waste operator licence and single-use plastic ban compliance
candidates.trigger: Waste Management Act 2014; Orders 15/2018 and 2020; fines VT500,000 individuals, VT1,000,000 companies.
candidates.unchecked: No recurring filing found; enforcement capacity described as low.

candidates.buyer: Resorts, farms, small commercial water users, well drillers
candidates.name: Waterworks permit and annual water-use licence handler
candidates.trigger: Water Resources Management Act 2002 (amended 2016): Form 1a waterworks permit then annual water-use licence.
candidates.unchecked: Number of licence holders; fees; enforcement level.

candidates.buyer: Fuel and LPG retailers and distributors
candidates.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
candidates.name: Petroleum pricing approval for fuel and LPG retailers (URA amendment)
candidates.trigger: Utilities Regulatory Authority Amendment Bill 2025 would add petroleum as a regulated service requiring URA approval of prices; passage unconfirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the bill passed; reporting formats; very few firms.

candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers (also 40)
candidates.name: Money changer / financial dealer licensing and reporting
candidates.trigger: Financial Dealers Licensing Act Cap 70 (2026 consolidation); Statute Law 2 of 2025; FIU reporting; Jan 2026 cash import/export SOP (applies to banks and reporting entities).
candidates.unchecked: Amendment contents; number of licensees; periodic reports required.

candidates.category: 31. Annual business licence renewal and quarterly turnover returns (VAT)
candidates.evidence: Already in study (K02, K04); not re-checked.
candidates.name: VSMS fiscal connector (already known)

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No household-specific search (breadth-first, budget). Employer pension duty already covered by K03 (VNPF 12% from 2026); no household-employer register found incidentally.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No search run; budget spent on country-specific regimes. No dealer licence regime seen incidentally.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No search run.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No gold trade or dealer regime surfaced in any result; low-value for Vanuatu (unverified, not searched).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No search run. Only vehicle-side finding is PLTA/public vehicle permits (see cat 18).

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Only found Biosecurity export health certificates for beef and a Senior Veterinary Officer contact (https://biosecurity.gov.vu/index.php/exports). No livestock trader register found; domestic regime unchecked.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Biosecurity certifies slaughter conditions only for commercial beef export; no small butcher register found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No search run.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: No search run beyond the Biosecurity contact.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Water Resources Management Act 2002 (amended 2016): waterworks permit (Form 1a) then annual water-use licence; no separate driller licence found. See C-water candidate (weak).

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Waste Management Act 2014: private waste operators (landfill, recycling, treatment) must be licensed; 2018/2020 plastic ban orders. No hauler-specific recurring filing found.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: No search run; no regime seen incidentally.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Covered by annual water-use licence (Dept of Water Resources) and URA (water and electricity regulated services). Nothing small-operator specific found.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: No search run.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Employment agency licence (2007 regulation), renewed annually, 60+ licensed SWP/RSE agents as of 2020; 2020 report of plan to abolish agents unconfirmed. Current status unverified.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No search run.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Only found Co-operative Societies Act (see 23). No charity/association annual-return regime searched; VFSC registers charitable associations (unverified).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: PLTA permits capped at 1,400 B-plate vans; annual public vehicle permit, driver permit (valid to 31 Dec, renewals from Nov), business licence; 2026 VT766m fuel support package required 2026 permit + licence + ID. See candidate.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers under Financial Dealers Licensing Act Cap 70 (2026 consolidation); no new rule found. Market traders: only generic business licence.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Only liquor/kava bar/restaurant municipal permits found (see candidate). Other premise types not searched.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: No licence regime found. URA Amendment Bill 2025 would add petroleum as a regulated service requiring price approval (status unconfirmed); Dept of Energy publishes LPG prices. Weak candidate.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Kava exporters: facility registration, OPS-014 audit, VCMB licence, annual re-audit. Copra/cocoa/coffee not searched.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Co-operative Societies Act Cap 152 Part 6 (ss35-38) annual returns, audit, inspection; Registrar office ORCBDS; ~460 co-ops, 17,428 members (ICAP 2026 snapshot). Credit unions/savings not searched.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Health practitioners need Health Practitioners Board certificate for business licence; no private facility register or insurer billing scheme found.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacist Practitioners Commission Board meets quarterly; Dangerous Drugs Act 1939 import permits via trade portal. No recurring register found.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Temporary and exemption work permit fees (VT60,000 / VT30,000) from 1 July 2025; visa renewals via MIDAS portal; employer statistical annual return due end March 2026. Security/cleaning agencies not specifically searched.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: No search run.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: AML/CTF Act 13 of 2014: reporting entity register, STR/SAR/CTR forms; FIU 2026 real-estate strategic analysis; 2026 amendment bill moves FIU under RBV. Whether agents/lawyers are registered reporting entities not confirmed.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Eight accommodation categories with licence codes D3(a)-(h); tourism permit plus business licence; July 2026 consultation on single-permit reform; 100 vatu/night levy only from a travel guide (unverified).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Kava export chain (see candidate); sea cucumber export needs ministerial written permission and a harvest ban; fish export processing establishment licence. Timber not searched.

coverage.category: 31. Annual business licence renewal and quarterly turnover returns (DCIR)
coverage.found: Renew by 31 Jan (2026: before 2 Feb); fee on prior-year turnover per category; 10% penalty per month; in-person payment; sector permits as prerequisites; quarterly turnover return form exists.

coverage.category: 32. Liquor, kava bar and municipal permits (Liquor Licensing Act Cap 52)
coverage.found: Multi-agency approval chain; renew 2 months ahead; non-transferable; fines VT50,000-100,000.

coverage.category: 33. Foreign Investment Approval Certificate holders (Foreign Investment Act 25 of 2019, amended 2021)
coverage.found: Certificate renewal precedes business licence renewal; notification duty for changes of details; reserved/restricted lists review due mid-2025 (outcome unconfirmed).

coverage.category: 34. Tourism permit and operator minimum standards (tour, transfer, activity operators)
coverage.found: Public liability insurance must be kept (May 2026); permit reform consultations July 2026 (single permit, one-time application, tiered VTOSS framework).

coverage.category: 35. Public vehicle permits (PLTA Act 2015)
coverage.found: See cat 18.

coverage.category: 36. Kava export facility registration and quality management (Kava Act 2002, Biosecurity OPS-014, VCMB)
coverage.found: Facility inspected and certified, VCMB licence, annual audit, per-shipment phytosanitary and export certificates, lab testing for kavalactones/flavokavins; Aug 2026 Biosecurity reminder.

coverage.category: 37. Employment Act statistical annual return and work-permit fees (Labour Dept directives)
coverage.found: See cat 26.

coverage.category: 38. Fisheries licences (Fisheries Regulations Cap 315) and sea cucumber / trochus controls
coverage.found: Local fishing licence, fish export processing establishment licence, written ministerial export permission; current fee/forms unconfirmed.

coverage.category: 39. Waste operator licences and single-use plastic ban (Waste Management Act 2014, Orders 15/2018 and 2020)
coverage.found: Fines up to VT500,000 individuals and VT1,000,000 companies; enforcement capacity low.

coverage.found: Act listed on VFSC legislation page; not opened; buyers unclear.
